ranked_facts.why: The presence of prior abdominal surgery is more likely to be associated with adhesions, which can cause bowel obstruction, than with other conditions such as norovirus gastroenteritis.
The small bowel obstruction pattern is more consistent with a mechanical obstruction, such as adhesions, than with a motility disorder.
